question_en: What is the name of the state in Western India?
passage_en: Gujarat, a state of western India, is lucky to have a long sea shore of 1500 kms. The state is rich in its folk arts and culture, because of migration of various communities from within India and abroad. Wooden idol worshippers Greeks, Sun worshippers Scythians, Baloch from Baluchistan, Siddis from Africa and Arabs are major foreign communities settled in Gujarat. Their regional music has strong influence on Gujarati folk. The folk songs of Saurashtra have an influence of Arabic musical tones. ‘Prabhatiya’ was introduced by Narsinh Mehta. ‘Bhavai’ is a folk drama credited to Asait Thakar. ‘Manbhatt’ is a storytelling musical tradition introduced by Mahakavi Premanand. ‘Garba’, ‘Dandia Ras’, ‘Tippani’, and ‘Hudo’ are famous folk dance forms. ‘Charan’ is a famous community for musical and literary talent.
